Hon’ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. Vaibhav Singh Chauhan, learned 
counsel for the Applicant.
2. Present C528 Application has been filed 
by the Applicant to quash the impugned order 
dated 04.08.2025 passed by learned Additional 
Chief Judicial Magistrate, District Haridwar 
whereby learned court below allowed the 
application under Section 311 of Cr.P.C. filed 
by the respondent in Complaint Case No.4093 
of 2024 (Old No.890 of 2018) in M/s Krishna 
Fruit & Company vs. Raj Kumar under Section 
138 of N.I. Act, pending in the court of learned 
Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, District 
Dehradun. 
3. Admit.
4. Issue notice to the respondent returnable at 
an early date.
5. Steps to be taken within one week.
6. Let the objection, if any, be filed by the 
respondent within two weeks.’
7. List on 08.10.2025. 
8. Having heard learned counsel for the 
parties, as an interim measure, till the next date 
of listing further proceedings of Complaint Case 
No.4093 of 2024 (Old No.890 of 2018) in M/s 
Krishna Fruit & Company vs. Raj Kumar for the 
offence punishable under Section 138 of N.I. 
Act, pending in the court of learned Additional 
Chief Judicial Magistrate, District Dehradun
shall remain stayed. 9. Interim relief application stands disposed 
of. 
 (Ashish Naithani, J.) 13.08.2025
